# Retail: STRING FUNCTIONS — instructor solutions

[Extra SUBSTRING practice with gradual difficulty](SUBSTRING_PRACTICE.md)

[Instructor index](README.md) · [Student questions](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md)

## Teaching and troubleshooting

Inspect the raw text and whitespace before comparing results. LEN excludes trailing spaces. Check one-based positions, absent delimiters, NULL propagation and whether trimming is requested.

Expected counts refer to the small original fixture. Run each answer independently; reset the fixture before independent mutation exercises. Equivalent SQL is acceptable when values, duplicates, NULL handling and required ordering agree.

### STRING_FUNCTIONS-01-01 — Length Function (LEN)

**Question**

[Canonical questions](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md)

**Reference answer**

```sql
SELECT OrderID, LEN(OrderReference) AS Result
FROM [retail].[Orders]
ORDER BY OrderID;
```

**Check and explain:** Return 12 rows. Preserve the fixture whitespace and NULL values; the reference expression specifies the expected result for every row.

### STRING_FUNCTIONS-14-01 — Case Statement (CASE)

**Question**

[Canonical questions](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md)

**Reference answer**

),

)

)

**Business report reference**

SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(LEN(f.[OrderReference]) AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(f.[SalesChannel] AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (

),

),

),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (

),

),

),

)

)

**Business report reference**

),

),

)

Allocation plus unmatched supply/demand must independently conserve both sides. Boundary-touching intervals allocate zero and must not appear.

;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(LOWER(f.[OrderReference]))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(LOWER(f.[OrderReference]) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
Supply AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(MetricValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY ActivityDate,EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS EndValue FROM E WHERE Kind='A' AND MetricValue>0
),
Demand AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(MetricValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY ActivityDate,EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS EndValue FROM E WHERE Kind='B' AND MetricValue>0
),
Matches AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS SupplyEventID,d.EventID AS DemandEventID,(CASE WHEN s.EndValue<d.EndValue THEN s.EndValue ELSE d.EndValue END)-(CASE WHEN s.EndValue-s.MetricValue>d.EndValue-d.MetricValue THEN s.EndValue-s.MetricValue ELSE d.EndValue-d.MetricValue END) AS AllocatedValue FROM Supply s JOIN Demand d ON d.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND s.EndValue>d.EndValue-d.MetricValue AND d.EndValue>s.EndValue-s.MetricValue
),
Result AS (
SELECT OwnerID,SupplyEventID,DemandEventID,AllocatedValue,CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) AS UnmatchedValue FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID,NULL,0,s.MetricValue-COALESCE(x.UsedValue,0) FROM Supply s LEFT JOIN(SELECT SupplyEventID,CAST(SUM(AllocatedValue) AS decimal(28,4)) AS UsedValue FROM Matches GROUP BY SupplyEventID)x ON x.SupplyEventID=s.EventID WHERE s.MetricValue>COALESCE(x.UsedValue,0) UNION ALL SELECT d.OwnerID,NULL,d.EventID,0,d.MetricValue-COALESCE(x.UsedValue,0) FROM Demand d LEFT JOIN(SELECT DemandEventID,CAST(SUM(AllocatedValue) AS decimal(28,4)) AS UsedValue FROM Matches GROUP BY DemandEventID)x ON x.DemandEventID=d.EventID WHERE d.MetricValue>COALESCE(x.UsedValue,0)
),
Report AS (

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. The supported chain has at most100 edges. A recursion-limit error is not acceptable cycle detection;IDs1 and11 must not be confused by substring matching.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(UPPER(f.[OrderReference]))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(UPPER(f.[OrderReference]) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1

)

```

**Business report reference**

SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(UPPER(f.[OrderReference]))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(UPPER(f.[OrderReference]) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
Walk AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS CurrentID,ParentID AS NextID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT w.StartID,e.EventID,e.ParentID,CAST(w.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),w.Depth+1 FROM Walk w JOIN E e ON e.EventID=w.NextID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',w.VisitPath)=0 AND w.Depth<100
),
Terminal AS (
SELECT w.*,CASE WHEN w.NextID IS NOT NULL AND CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(w.NextID AS varchar(12))+'/',w.VisitPath)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CycleFlag,CASE WHEN w.NextID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM E e WHERE e.EventID=w.NextID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BoundaryFlag FROM Walk w WHERE w.NextID IS NULL OR CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(w.NextID AS varchar(12))+'/',w.VisitPath)>0 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM E e WHERE e.EventID=w.NextID)
),
Report AS (

)
SELECT [EventID] AS [OrderID],[TerminalEventID] AS [TerminalEventID],[RootEventID] AS [RootEventID],[Depth] AS [Depth],[CycleFlag] AS [CycleFlag],[BoundaryFlag] AS [BoundaryFlag],[VisitPath] AS [VisitPath] FROM Report ORDER BY OrderID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

)

),

),

),
Supply AS (

),

),

),

),

)

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-05-A09

**Conserved largest-remainder allocation**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-05-a09)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Independent rounded percentages need not sum to10000. Compare exact remainders,not ratios rounded before flooring. Input positive totals in one segment are bounded by10^18 and analysis values have at most four fractional digits. **Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. The supported chain has at most100 edges. A recursion-limit error is not acceptable cycle detection;IDs1 and11 must not be confused by substring matching.

**Analysis audit reference**

)

),

),

),
Walk AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS CurrentID,ParentID AS NextID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT w.StartID,e.EventID,e.ParentID,CAST(w.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),w.Depth+1 FROM Walk w JOIN E e ON e.EventID=w.NextID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',w.VisitPath)=0 AND w.Depth<100
),
Terminal AS (

),

)

),

),

),

),

)

),

)

),

),

),

),
N AS (

),
P AS (

),

),

),

)

**Analysis audit reference**

),

),

),

)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Do not add the same descendant twice or hide a rootless cycle. Supported paths have at most100 edges.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (

**Business report reference**

;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(LTRIM(f.[OrderReference]))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(LTRIM(f.[OrderReference]) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (

),
Down AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS NodeID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT d.StartID,e.EventID,CAST(d.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),d.Depth+1 FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)=0 AND d.Depth<100
),
DistinctNodes AS (
SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (

),
Report AS (

)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. ),

)

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(LTRIM(f.[OrderReference]))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(LTRIM(f.[OrderReference]) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (

),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Do not add the same descendant twice or hide a rootless cycle. Supported paths have at most100 edges.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (

**Business report reference**

),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (

),
Down AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS NodeID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT d.StartID,e.EventID,CAST(d.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),d.Depth+1 FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)=0 AND d.Depth<100
),

),

),

),

)

)

**Business report reference**

),
E AS (

),

),

),
N AS (

),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),

),

),

)

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-09-A13

**Distinct descendant exposure with cycles**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-09-a13)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Do not add the same descendant twice or hide a rootless cycle. Supported paths have at most100 edges.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(CHARINDEX(N'-',f.[OrderReference]) AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(f.[SalesChannel] AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(CHARINDEX(N'-',f.[OrderReference]) AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(f.[SalesChannel] AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
Down AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS NodeID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT d.StartID,e.EventID,CAST(d.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),d.Depth+1 FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)=0 AND d.Depth<100
),
DistinctNodes AS (
SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (
SELECT DISTINCT d.StartID FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)>0
),
Report AS (
SELECT e.EventID,COALESCE(t.DescendantCount,0) AS DescendantCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.StartID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,CASE WHEN c.StartID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CycleFlag FROM E e LEFT JOIN T t ON t.StartID=e.EventID LEFT JOIN Cycles c ON c.StartID=e.EventID
)
SELECT [EventID] AS [OrderID],[DescendantCount] AS [DescendantCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[CycleFlag] AS [CycleFlag] FROM Report ORDER BY OrderID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

**Best mean-centered contiguous block**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-09-a14)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (

),

)

```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(CHARINDEX(N'-',f.[OrderReference]) AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(f.[SalesChannel] AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Do not add the same descendant twice or hide a rootless cycle. Supported paths have at most100 edges.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (

),

)

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(LEFT(f.[OrderReference],3))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(LEFT(f.[OrderReference],3) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
Down AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS NodeID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT d.StartID,e.EventID,CAST(d.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),d.Depth+1 FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)=0 AND d.Depth<100
),
DistinctNodes AS (
SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (

),
Report AS (
SELECT e.EventID,COALESCE(t.DescendantCount,0) AS DescendantCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.StartID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,CASE WHEN c.StartID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CycleFlag FROM E e LEFT JOIN T t ON t.StartID=e.EventID LEFT JOIN Cycles c ON c.StartID=e.EventID
)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

)

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(LEFT(f.[OrderReference],3))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(LEFT(f.[OrderReference],3) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)

SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(RIGHT(f.[OrderReference],3))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(RIGHT(f.[OrderReference],3) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
Down AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS NodeID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT d.StartID,e.EventID,CAST(d.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),d.Depth+1 FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)=0 AND d.Depth<100
),
DistinctNodes AS (
SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (
SELECT DISTINCT d.StartID FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)>0
),
Report AS (
SELECT e.EventID,COALESCE(t.DescendantCount,0) AS DescendantCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.StartID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,CASE WHEN c.StartID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CycleFlag FROM E e LEFT JOIN T t ON t.StartID=e.EventID LEFT JOIN Cycles c ON c.StartID=e.EventID
)
SELECT [EventID] AS [OrderID],[DescendantCount] AS [DescendantCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[CycleFlag] AS [CycleFlag] FROM Report ORDER BY OrderID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-11-A14

**Best mean-centered contiguous block**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-11-a14)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(RIGHT(f.[OrderReference],3))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(RIGHT(f.[OrderReference],3) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(RIGHT(f.[OrderReference],3))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(RIGHT(f.[OrderReference],3) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[EventCount] AS [EventCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[LineValue] AS [LineValue],[PaidValue] AS [PaidValue],[Outstanding] AS [Outstanding],[DistinctProducts] AS [DistinctProducts] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

```sql

),

),

)

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (

),

**Business report reference**

),

),
Report AS (

)

),
Demand AS (

),

SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS SupplyEventID,d.EventID AS DemandEventID,(CASE WHEN s.EndValue<d.EndValue THEN s.EndValue ELSE d.EndValue END)-(CASE WHEN s.EndValue-s.MetricValue>d.EndValue-d.MetricValue THEN s.EndValue-s.MetricValue ELSE d.EndValue-d.MetricValue END) AS AllocatedValue FROM Supply s JOIN Demand d ON d.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND s.EndValue>d.EndValue-d.MetricValue AND d.EndValue>s.EndValue-s.MetricValue
),
Result AS (

),
Report AS (

)

SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS NodeID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT d.StartID,e.EventID,CAST(d.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),d.Depth+1 FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)=0 AND d.Depth<100
),
DistinctNodes AS (
SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (
SELECT DISTINCT d.StartID FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)>0
),
Report AS (
SELECT e.EventID,COALESCE(t.DescendantCount,0) AS DescendantCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.StartID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,CASE WHEN c.StartID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CycleFlag FROM E e LEFT JOIN T t ON t.StartID=e.EventID LEFT JOIN Cycles c ON c.StartID=e.EventID
)
SELECT [EventID] AS [OrderID],[DescendantCount] AS [DescendantCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[CycleFlag] AS [CycleFlag] FROM Report ORDER BY OrderID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-12-A14

**Best mean-centered contiguous block**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-12-a14)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(REVERSE(f.[OrderReference]))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(REVERSE(f.[OrderReference]) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(REVERSE(f.[OrderReference]))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(REVERSE(f.[OrderReference]) AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

),

),

),

),
Cycles AS (

),
Report AS (

)

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-13-A14

**Best mean-centered contiguous block**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-13-a14)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(REPLACE(f.[OrderReference],N'-',N''))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(REPLACE(f.[OrderReference],N'-',N'') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(REPLACE(f.[OrderReference],N'-',N''))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(REPLACE(f.[OrderReference],N'-',N'') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. A gap exactly30 remains in the session. Null or zero previous total gives null growth. Unknown rows still keep a session active.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(CASE f.[OrderStatus] WHEN 'Open' THEN 1 WHEN 'Pending' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(f.[SalesChannel] AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),

SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)

**Business report reference**

),

),

),

),

)

DistinctNodes AS (
SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (
SELECT DISTINCT d.StartID FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)>0
),
Report AS (
SELECT e.EventID,COALESCE(t.DescendantCount,0) AS DescendantCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.StartID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,CASE WHEN c.StartID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CycleFlag FROM E e LEFT JOIN T t ON t.StartID=e.EventID LEFT JOIN Cycles c ON c.StartID=e.EventID
)
SELECT [EventID] AS [OrderID],[DescendantCount] AS [DescendantCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[CycleFlag] AS [CycleFlag] FROM Report ORDER BY OrderID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-14-A14

**Best mean-centered contiguous block**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-14-a14)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(CASE f.[OrderStatus] WHEN 'Open' THEN 1 WHEN 'Pending' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(f.[SalesChannel] AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(CASE f.[OrderStatus] WHEN 'Open' THEN 1 WHEN 'Pending' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(f.[SalesChannel] AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

)

),

),

),

)

SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (
SELECT DISTINCT d.StartID FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)>0
),
Report AS (
SELECT e.EventID,COALESCE(t.DescendantCount,0) AS DescendantCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.StartID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,CASE WHEN c.StartID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CycleFlag FROM E e LEFT JOIN T t ON t.StartID=e.EventID LEFT JOIN Cycles c ON c.StartID=e.EventID
)
SELECT [EventID] AS [OrderID],[DescendantCount] AS [DescendantCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[CycleFlag] AS [CycleFlag] FROM Report ORDER BY OrderID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-15-A14

**Best mean-centered contiguous block**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-15-a14)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(ISNULL(f.[Note],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(ISNULL(f.[Note],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(ISNULL(f.[Note],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(ISNULL(f.[Note],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

),

SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
D AS (
SELECT DISTINCT OwnerID,ActivityDate AS TriggerDate FROM E
),
W AS (
SELECT d.OwnerID,d.TriggerDate,e.Kind AS Segment,e.EventID,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY d.OwnerID,d.TriggerDate,e.Kind ORDER BY e.ActivityDate DESC,e.EventID DESC) AS Position FROM D d JOIN E e ON e.OwnerID=d.OwnerID AND e.ActivityDate>=DATEADD(day,-29,d.TriggerDate) AND e.ActivityDate<=d.TriggerDate WHERE e.Kind IN('A','B','C')
),
P AS (
SELECT OwnerID,TriggerDate,MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='A' THEN EventID END) AS AEventID,MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='B' THEN EventID END) AS BEventID,MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='C' THEN EventID END) AS CEventID FROM W WHERE Position=1 GROUP BY OwnerID,TriggerDate HAVING COUNT(*)=3
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY TriggerDate) AS Choice FROM P
),
Report AS (
SELECT OwnerID,TriggerDate,AEventID,BEventID,CEventID FROM R WHERE Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[TriggerDate] AS [TriggerDate],[AEventID] AS [AEventID],[BEventID] AS [BEventID],[CEventID] AS [CEventID] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-16-A13

**Distinct descendant exposure with cycles**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-16-a13)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Do not add the same descendant twice or hide a rootless cycle. Supported paths have at most100 edges.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
Down AS (
SELECT EventID AS StartID,EventID AS NodeID,CAST('/'+CAST(EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)) AS VisitPath,0 AS Depth FROM E UNION ALL SELECT d.StartID,e.EventID,CAST(d.VisitPath+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/' AS varchar(max)),d.Depth+1 FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)=0 AND d.Depth<100
),
DistinctNodes AS (
SELECT DISTINCT StartID,NodeID FROM Down WHERE Depth>0
),
T AS (
SELECT d.StartID,COUNT(*) AS DescendantCount,COUNT(e.MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(e.MetricValue) AS TotalValue FROM DistinctNodes d JOIN E e ON e.EventID=d.NodeID GROUP BY d.StartID
),
Cycles AS (
SELECT DISTINCT d.StartID FROM Down d JOIN E e ON e.ParentID=d.NodeID WHERE CHARINDEX('/'+CAST(e.EventID AS varchar(12))+'/',d.VisitPath)>0
),
Report AS (
SELECT e.EventID,COALESCE(t.DescendantCount,0) AS DescendantCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.StartID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,CASE WHEN c.StartID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS CycleFlag FROM E e LEFT JOIN T t ON t.StartID=e.EventID LEFT JOIN Cycles c ON c.StartID=e.EventID
)
SELECT [EventID] AS [OrderID],[DescendantCount] AS [DescendantCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[CycleFlag] AS [CycleFlag] FROM Report ORDER BY OrderID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

#### RETAIL-STRING_FUNCTIONS-16-A14

**Best mean-centered contiguous block**

[Canonical question](../questions/STRING_FUNCTIONS.md#retail-string_functions-16-a14)

**Assessment model:** The two result sets must match complete values,nulls,multiplicity and required ordering. Compute N/T over the complete owner,not separately per known block. Even nonnegative stored values can have negative scores. Never choose an empty zero block. Reference cardinality<=1000 rows per owner;explain a scalable prefix-based alternative for larger inputs.

**Analysis audit reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
)
SELECT EventID AS [OrderID],OwnerID AS [CustomerID],ActivityDate AS AnalysisDate,MetricValue AS AnalysisValue,Segment AS AnalysisSegment,ParentID AS AnalysisParentID,Kind AS AnalysisKind FROM E ORDER BY EventID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
OwnerStats AS (
SELECT OwnerID,COUNT(MetricValue) AS KnownCount,SUM(MetricValue) AS KnownTotal FROM E GROUP BY OwnerID
),
N AS (
SELECT e.*,CAST(s.KnownCount AS decimal(4,0))*e.MetricValue-CAST(s.KnownTotal AS decimal(28,4)) AS ScoreValue,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID) AS Position,SUM(CASE WHEN e.MetricValue IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY e.OwnerID ORDER BY e.ActivityDate,e.EventID ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS BlockID FROM E e JOIN OwnerStats s ON s.OwnerID=e.OwnerID
),
P AS (
SELECT *,CAST(SUM(ScoreValue) OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID,BlockID ORDER BY Position ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS decimal(28,4)) AS PrefixValue FROM N WHERE MetricValue IS NOT NULL
),
C AS (
SELECT s.OwnerID,s.EventID AS StartEventID,e.EventID AS EndEventID,s.Position AS StartPosition,e.Position AS EndPosition,e.PrefixValue-s.PrefixValue+s.ScoreValue AS BlockScore,e.Position-s.Position+1 AS EventCount FROM P s JOIN P e ON e.OwnerID=s.OwnerID AND e.BlockID=s.BlockID AND e.Position>=s.Position
),
R AS (
SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY OwnerID ORDER BY BlockScore DESC,StartPosition,EndPosition) AS Choice FROM C
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,r.StartEventID,r.EndEventID,r.BlockScore,COALESCE(r.EventCount,0) AS EventCount FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN R r ON r.OwnerID=o.OwnerID AND r.Choice=1
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[StartEventID] AS [StartEventID],[EndEventID] AS [EndEventID],[BlockScore] AS [BlockScore],[EventCount] AS [EventCount] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
```

),

)

**Business report reference**

```sql
;WITH Focus_FocusRows AS (
SELECT f.[OrderID] AS EventID,f.[CustomerID] AS OwnerID,CAST(f.[OrderDate] AS date) AS ActivityDate,CAST(DATALENGTH(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing'))/2.0 AS decimal(28,4)) AS MetricValue,CAST(COALESCE(f.[Note],f.[BackupNote],N'missing') AS nvarchar(100)) AS Segment,f.[ParentOrderID] AS ParentID FROM [retail].[Orders] f WHERE 1=1
),
E AS (
SELECT x.*,original.[SalesChannel] AS Kind FROM Focus_FocusRows x JOIN [retail].[Orders] original ON original.[OrderID]=x.EventID
),
Owners AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID FROM [retail].[Customers]
),
Eligible AS (
SELECT f.* FROM [retail].[Orders] f JOIN E e ON e.EventID=f.[OrderID]
),
HeaderTotals AS (
SELECT [CustomerID] AS OwnerID,COUNT(*) AS EventCount,COUNT([OrderTotal]) AS KnownCount,SUM([OrderTotal]) AS TotalValue FROM Eligible GROUP BY [CustomerID]
),
Lines AS (
SELECT e.CustomerID AS OwnerID,SUM(i.Quantity*i.UnitPrice) AS LineValue,COUNT(DISTINCT p.ProductID) AS DistinctProducts FROM Eligible e JOIN retail.OrderItems i ON i.OrderID=e.OrderID JOIN retail.Products p ON p.ProductID=i.ProductID GROUP BY e.CustomerID
),
Paid AS (
SELECT e.CustomerID AS OwnerID,SUM(p.PaidAmount) AS PaidValue FROM Eligible e JOIN retail.Payments p ON p.OrderID=e.OrderID GROUP BY e.CustomerID
),
Report AS (
SELECT o.OwnerID,COALESCE(t.EventCount,0) AS EventCount,COALESCE(t.KnownCount,0) AS KnownCount,CASE WHEN t.OwnerID IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(38,4)) ELSE t.TotalValue END AS TotalValue,COALESCE(l.LineValue,0) AS LineValue,COALESCE(p.PaidValue,0) AS PaidValue,(CASE WHEN t.OwnerID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE t.TotalValue END)-COALESCE(p.PaidValue,0) AS Outstanding,COALESCE(l.DistinctProducts,0) AS DistinctProducts FROM Owners o LEFT JOIN HeaderTotals t ON t.OwnerID=o.OwnerID LEFT JOIN Lines l ON l.OwnerID=o.OwnerID LEFT JOIN Paid p ON p.OwnerID=o.OwnerID
)
SELECT [OwnerID] AS [CustomerID],[EventCount] AS [EventCount],[KnownCount] AS [KnownCount],[TotalValue] AS [TotalValue],[LineValue] AS [LineValue],[PaidValue] AS [PaidValue],[Outstanding] AS [Outstanding],[DistinctProducts] AS [DistinctProducts] FROM Report ORDER BY CustomerID OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);
